Message:
Alone in the rubble of
long-faded ruins,
I waited for death
to take me.
I was the only living thing here.

If I let the flower-like growths
drain my life,
it would all be over.

Suddenly, I heard
someone call my name.
I looked up...
only to see my friend appear
from behind a withered tree.

She called out to me, worried,
but with the same old
smile on her face...

Overjoyed, I started
running towards her...
until the dry crackle of
something crumbling beneath me
brought me back to my senses.

I glanced down at
the withered plants,
and I swore I saw my friend
lying there, unresponsive...

“Y-You’re scared of me,
aren’t you?
So what are you doing here?
I hate two-faced snakes like you!”

...My friend, with tears
streaming down her face,
could only squeak out
a small, “I’m sorry,”
before running off.

...Haha. I was only trying to
look out for my friend,
but I just ended up hurting her...
I’m such an idiot...
